svg.aria-label: Animated slope chart for ten models. Before fine-tuning, moving the candidate descriptions from the options into the record raises the decoders (JEV-9B 49% to 78%, Open-Jev-9B 61% to 89%) and lowers the encoders (bekko 84% to 39%, von 52% to 27%, GLiNER 40% to 25%). After fine-tuning both layouts reach 90–97%. With no descriptions at all, every model falls to 62–73% even after fine-tuning.

g.text: Before training: each model, with the candidates’ descriptions written next to the options.
Move the descriptions into the record instead: the decoders gain up to 29 points, the encoders lose up to 44.
After fine-tuning, the layout hardly matters: both land at 90–97%.
What does matter is the descriptions: without them, every model falls to 62–73%.
One run per cell: differences under ~3 points are noise.
